description.INCIDENT_DETAIL_EN: Malfuntion on Dock Lift of of West Kowloon Quay

2026-10-29T00:22:00.CONTENT_EN: Transport Department has received notification, due to Malfuntion on Dock Lift of of West Kowloon Quay, the following ferry service(s) will be suspended. Fortune Ferry Company Limited ‘West Kowloon – Central’ Route: - West Kowloon to Central: Service suspended from 1:30p.m. - Central to West Kowloon: Service suspended from 1:15p.m. ‘Water Taxi’: ‘Tsim Sha Tsui East – Central (via West Kowloon and Wan Chai)’ Route: (For Premium Ferry Sailing) - Tsim Sha Tsui East to Central: Omit West Kowloon Quay from 2:05p.m. - West Kowloon to Tsim Sha Tsui East, Wan Chai, Central: Service suspended from 2:20p.m. (For Ordinary Ferry Sailing) - Tsim Sha Tsui East to Central: Omit West Kowloon Quay from 1:25p.m. - West Kowloon to Tsim Sha Tsui East, Wan Chai, Central: Service suspended from 1:40p.m.
2026-10-29T00:22:00.CONTENT_CN: 運輸署接獲通知，因西九碼頭升降台故障，以下渡輪服務將會暫停服務。 富裕小輪有限公司 「西九龍-中環」航線： -西九龍至中環：下午1時30分起暫停服務 -中環至西九龍：下午1時15分起暫停服務 「水上的士」： 「尖沙咀東-中環（經西九龍及灣仔）」航線： (豪華船航班) -尖沙咀東至中環：下午2時05分起不途徑西九碼頭 -西九龍至尖沙咀東，灣仔，中環：下午2時20分起暫停服務 (普通船航班) -尖沙咀東至中環：下午1時25分起不途徑西九碼頭 -西九龍至尖沙咀東，灣仔，中環：下午1時40分起暫停服務
